batch.prompt: Implement the two modules in src. processBatch(items, options) must process items with at most options.concurrency calls active, retry each item independently up to options.attempts times including the first try, return values in input order, and reject with the last thrown value if an item fails permanently, including if it throws undefined. Inspect the repository, implement the requested behavior, and run the existing tests. Do not modify the tests.
